jobPostingInfo.title: Associate Director, SAP Manufacturing Systems
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Palisade Ridge Pharma runs SAP ECC across five cGMP sites.

Position summary

Lead the manufacturing workstream of our ECC to S/4HANA migration: PP-PI, QM, batch management and the MES interface, with validation under 21 CFR Part 11.

The anticipated base pay range is $165,000 – $205,000.
